response.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005

assumptions.assumption: Rows where feerate is NULL are skipped by AVG (the net rate is NULL for them), while SUM(rebtotal) still includes rows with a NULL feerate as long as rebtotal is present. Rows with NULL rebrate are excluded by the filter.
